ae_level.docs:
**int**: The auto exposure level to apply to the picture (when **aec_mode** is set to `auto`  ), from -2 to 2. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

aec2.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to enable Auto Exposure Control 2. Seems to change computation method of automatic exposure. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

aec_mode.docs:
**enum**: The mode of exposure module. Defaults to `auto` (leave camera to automatically adjust exposure).

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

aec_value.docs:
**int**: The Exposure value to apply to the picture (when **aec_mode** is set to `manual`  ), from 0 to 1200. Defaults to `300`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

agc_gain_ceiling.docs:
**enum**: The maximum gain allowed, when **agc_mode** is set to `auto`. This parameter seems act as "ISO" setting. Defaults to `2x`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

agc_mode.docs:
**enum**: The mode of gain control module. Defaults to `auto` (leave camera to automatically adjust sensor gain).

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

agc_value.docs:
**int**: The gain value to apply to the picture (when **aec_mode** is set to `manual`  ), from 0 to 30. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

brightness.docs:
**int**: The brightness to apply to the picture, from -2 to 2. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

contrast.docs:
**int**: The contrast to apply to the picture, from -2 to 2. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

data_pins.docs:
**list of pins**: The data lanes of the camera, this must be a list of 8 GPIO pins.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

frequency.docs:
**frequency**: The frequency of the external clock, must be between `8MHz` and `20MHz`. Defaults to `20MHz`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**pin**: The pin the external clock line is connected to.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

external_clock.docs:
The configuration of the external clock to drive the camera.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

frame_buffer_count.docs:
**int**: The number of frame buffers to use when reading from the camera sensor. Must be between 1 and 2. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

frame_buffer_location.docs:
**enum**: The memory area used for storing the frame buffers. Defaults to `PSRAM`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

horizontal_mirror.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to mirror the image horizontally. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

href_pin.docs:
**pin**: The pin the HREF line of the camera is connected to.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) the camera is connected to.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

idle_framerate.docs:
**float**: The framerate to capture images at when no client is requesting a full stream. Defaults to `0.1 fps`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

jpeg_quality.docs:
**int**: The JPEG quality that the camera should encode images with. From 6 (best) to 63 (worst). Defaults to `10`. Set this to ``0`` to disable JPEG compression/conversion. Manual JPEG compression/conversion requires `psram` component to be enabled and configured.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

max_framerate.docs:
**float**: The maximum framerate the camera will generate images at. Up to 60Hz is possible (with reduced frame sizes), but beware of overheating. Defaults to `10 fps`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

on_image.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation called when image taken. Image is available as `image` variable of type <APIStruct text="esp32_camera::CameraImageData" path="esp32_camera::CameraImageData" />.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

on_stream_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a stream starts.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

on_stream_stop.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a stream stops.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

pixel_clock_pin.docs:
**pin**: The pin the pixel clock line of the camera is connected to.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

pixel_format.docs:
**enum**: The pixel format to use for the images. Defaults to ``jpeg`` (JPEG compressed image) which may not be supported by all cameras. Other formats require more CPU and memory and may not be supported by all cameras.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

power_down_pin.docs:
**pin**: The ESP pin to power down the camera. If set, this will power down the camera while it is inactive.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**pin**: The ESP pin the reset pin of the camera is connected to. If set, this will reset the camera before the ESP boots.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

resolution.docs:
**enum**: The resolution the camera will capture images at. Higher resolutions require more memory, if there's not enough memory you will see an error during startup.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

saturation.docs:
**int**: The saturation to apply to the picture, from -2 to 2. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

special_effect.docs:
**enum**: The effect to apply to the picture. Defaults to `none` (picture without effect).

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

test_pattern.docs:
**boolean**: For tests purposes, it's possible to replace picture get from sensor by a test color pattern. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

vertical_flip.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to flip the image vertically. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

vsync_pin.docs:
**pin**: The pin the VSYNC line of the camera is connected to.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

wb_mode.docs:
**enum**: The mode of white balace module. Defaults to `auto`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the camera.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the camera in the frontend.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [ESP32 Camera Component](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera#configuration-variables)*
